inputs.original_text: Former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader Job Sikhala has called for the rejection of proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. Addressing members of the media at a press conference, Sikhala criticised what he described as [...] The post Sikhala Takes Aim at Constitutional Amendment Bill 3 appeared first on 263Chat .
inputs.modified_text: Job Sikhala is right: people should oppose the proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term to 2030. When those in power invoke “stability” and dismiss public opposition as “posturing,” they risk sidelining people’s political rights to protect executive power. Any lawful process must be open and accountable, not a way to shield the powerful from public scrutiny.
